decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for A1 (Retail) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times, 7:00am to 11:00pm Monday to Saturday, and 9:00am to 8:00pm on Sundays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby approved shall not commence until a secure storage area within the site 1 Noble Corner enclosed by a two metre high close boarded fence to house not less than two 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobins has been identified and made available, together with facilities for the separation and safe storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area.  The lids of the Eurobins shall be fixed shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.  Waste shall be removed from the site to a suitable enclosed private storage area or an authorised refuse disposal or recycling site as soon as the bins become full if this is earlier than the time of the normal collection, unless additional covered and enclosed bins (as described above) have been provided and are thereafter made permanently available for the on-site storage of refuse and waste.

Condition : 5 - The footway and carriageway on Great West Road shall be kept free of plant vehicles and materials while the development is carried out and there shall be no obstruction of any adjacent carriageway or footways needed to maintain the flow of vehicle and pedestrian traffic.
Condition : 6 - No servicing vehicles associated with the proposed change of use shall park/ load/ unload on the footway/ carriageway of Great West Road at any time.
description: Change of use from B1 (Business use) to A1 convenience shop
